# Project Overview

This learning portfolio documents SQL techniques for selecting,
filtering, grouping, and summarizing data.

# Skills Demonstrated

- Conditional transformations with `CASE`
- Row-level filtering with `WHERE`
- Group-level filtering with `HAVING`
- Aggregate and conditional-aggregate functions
- Analytical queries for customer and marketing data

# Business Application

These SQL techniques can support campaign measurement, customer
segmentation, survey analysis, conversion-rate calculations, and
performance reporting.
